//: Curated rules consumed by scripts/refresh-data.mjs. Hand-edited only.

poolExclusions.//: Entries matching any of these are dropped from the rollable pool.

canonicalization.//: After exclusions, collapse to ONE entry per item name. Highest-priority version wins; '' (no version) beats everything.

ammo.//: Ammo-slot classification. Name rules run in order, first match wins; unmatched -> 'any' (blessings, misc). Weapon overrides beat category mapping (Bow->arrow, Crossbow->bolt).

categoryAmmoMap.//: Weapon category -> required ammo class. Categories absent here need no specific ammo (their ammo slot rolls 'any').

selfAmmoWeapons.//: Weapons whose category implies ammo but that need none (crystal-type bows; blowpipe is already Thrown). Their ammo slot rolls 'any'.
